title: Wilson Green works with Puharich at the Round Table

tellings.quote: guy Wilson Green was working with Puharich in the 50s at the round table doing everything they

plain: In the 1950s, a man named Wilson Green is said to have worked with a researcher named Puharich at the Round Table, a private research lab, where they were "doing everything." An unnamed researcher on the show says this without giving a source, though he credits Puharich's own journals. He tells it to show who was involved in the lab's early experiments, in an episode about a scientist said to have contacted an alien council.
